name: heartbeat-test-deadline
goal: Allow the heartbeat CLI test to exercise its real one-second expiry without a five-second test-runner cutoff.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Heartbeat CLI test needs real TTL expiry plus several subprocess calls; five-second runner cutoff interrupts assertions.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Full CLI run timed out at5000ms: /tmp/harness-remote-fallback-full-check.log, heartbeat test. Production TTL behavior unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Set only this test-runner budget to30seconds; preserve TTL1second, wait1300ms, and every assertion. Independent review approved.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 7/7 passed: /tmp/harness-heartbeat-deadline-green.log. Full combined checks remain pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
